city_center.name: Ybor City + Tampa Riverwalk
city_center.landmark: Ybor City historic Latin district (cigar-era brick), Tampa Riverwalk along the Hillsborough River; Plant City strawberry country to the east
city_center.notes: Tampa Bay metro with the Ybor City Cuban/Spanish/Italian heritage core. Publix (Lakeland FL headquarters) is the home grocer, headquartered just up the road in Polk County. Plant City is the winter strawberry capital of the state. source: Publix footprint; Plant City strawberry heritage.

featured_frontier.signature_ingredient: Plant City strawberries (Dec-Mar peak) + Florida citrus; Cuban-bread tie

languages.reason: Spanish is the leading second home language across the Tampa Bay metro, with deep Ybor City Cuban/Spanish roots. Percentage INFERRED (localization pipeline data absent) -- not an ACS figure

cultural_notes: Ybor City is Tampa's historic Latin district, built by Cuban, Spanish, and Italian cigar-industry immigrants; its brick and wrought-iron fabric anchors the city's cultural identity (source: general regional knowledge; language selection flagged INFERRED)

Plant City, east of Tampa, is Florida's winter strawberry capital -- the Florida Strawberry Festival runs late February to early March, at the peak of the Dec-Mar strawberry season (source: fdacs.gov Crops-in-Season strawberry Dec-Apr; UF/IFAS strawberry peak Dec-Mar)
Florida's near-tropical calendar makes winter the peak of citrus and strawberry, not a produce off-season (source: fdacs.gov; sarasotamagazine.com)
Publix is headquartered in nearby Lakeland (Polk County) and is the dominant home grocer across the Tampa Bay metro (source: Publix regional footprint)
